name: Estival-Pingo
description: The sea here is thick with dissolved metals, so sunsets burn green and gold above the waves. Beneath them wait a binary sunset, and everything the light never reaches.

The air carries dust and something faintly floral, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts. Small darting fauna nest in the cliff-vents, timing their flights between gusts.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
There is money in water here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
